6549.title: Standalone shell height investigation
6549.rootCauseOneLine: A shorter visualViewport.height overrides standalone full-height CSS without keyboard focus; whether the affected phone supplies that mismatch is unverified.
6549.proposedFix: Measure the affected phone viewport and resolved safe areas before changing standalone height or padding ownership.
6549.caveats: The conditional hook probe repeats in two clean checkouts. Actual foldable hardware and rendered verification are unavailable. No screenshot, device root-cause confirmation, or safe production fix is claimed.
